hints.sentence: A moderator works from the centre's marked record, so the difference a sample records is only part of the difference a marker working cold would find.
A centre is sampled once in its rota cycle, and the marks it banks in the other years are not given at the level its sampled year shows.
Each board's moderators are standardised to their own principal, so a board's moderation measures its centres against its own standard and not Carrow's.

judgments.name: a moderator's recorded difference is a share of the difference a marker working without the centre's marks finds, measured board by board on the trial scripts joined to the live moderation of the same portfolio
a centre's marks in the years between samples sit at the level its own mark sheets show for that year after a sample, within centre and net of the board's year
each board's standard is placed against Carrow's through the moderators registered with two boards, each side taken to its own agreed marks
